mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, u.role AS senderRole, COALESCE(r.name, u.nickname, CONCAT(LEFT(u.phone, 3), '****', RIGHT(u.phone, 4))) AS senderName, m.content, m.created_at AS createdAt FROM messages m JOIN users u ON m.sender_id = u.id LEFT JOIN resumes r ON m.sender_id = r.user_id WHERE m.application_id = #{applicationId} ORDER BY m.created_at
